say:1:1536101501:1.text: This festival bears the Hunting Goddess' name. It exists to choose the strongest!
say:1:1536101501:1.source_cn: 是狩猎神大人赐名的盛大节日，用于选拔最英勇善战的勇士！
say:1:1536101501:1.male: This festival bears the Hunting Goddess' name. It exists to choose the strongest!
say:1:1536101501:1.female: This festival bears the Hunting Goddess' name. It exists to choose the strongest!

say:2:1536101502:1.text: The last Bloodhunt was more than ten years ago...
say:2:1536101502:1.source_cn: 上一次举办，都是十多年前的事了……
say:2:1536101502:1.male: The last Bloodhunt was more than ten years ago...
say:2:1536101502:1.female: The last Bloodhunt was more than ten years ago...
